title: CLI logins
description: Log in to a CLI once per token set; WS Sandbox Proxy keeps each value encrypted and write-only, and installs it in the sandboxes you attach it to.

unavailable.title: CLI logins are not available
unavailable.description: This server has not enabled CLI logins. Ask the operator to enable them.

readOnly: CLI logins are switched off on this server. You can review and delete logins, but not create or change them.

empty.title: No logins yet
empty.description: Add a definition below, then create a login from it.

definitions.heading: Definitions
definitions.description: JSON documents that describe how a CLI logs in and where its tokens live. Each saved version is immutable.
definitions.label: Login definitions
definitions.title: {{name}} v{{version}}
definitions.addDescription: Paste the definition JSON. Saving a definition with an existing id adds a new version of it.
definitions.jsonHint: Checked as you type with the same rules the server applies.

warning.browserCallback: This definition uses the browser-callback method, which WS Sandbox Proxy cannot run yet. You can still upload values for it.

definitions.archiveDescription: Archived versions can't be used for new logins or re-pins. Logins already pinned to it keep working.

empty.title: No definitions yet
empty.description: Add a definition to describe a CLI's login command and token files or environment variables.

create.title: Create a login
create.description: A login pins one definition version. Add accounts and instances on its page afterwards.
create.modeExclusive: Exclusive: each instance is used by one sandbox at a time, and its tokens are copied back when the sandbox stops.
create.modeShareable: Shareable: several sandboxes can use one instance at once. Nothing is copied back.

form.name: Name
form.optionalNameHint: Leave the name empty to use the number instead.
form.noDefinitions: No definitions are available. Add one first.
form.deliveryHint: Proxied delivery keeps API keys out of the sandbox entirely. Delivery can't be changed after the login is created.
form.copyBack: Copy tokens back when a sandbox stops
form.foreignAllowed: Allow hosts I don't own (shared pools)
form.checkpointHint: 5 to 240. Leave empty to turn checkpoints off.
form.checkpointRange: Enter a whole number from 5 to 240, or leave it empty.
form.maxConcurrentEditHint: Leave empty for unlimited. Lowering it does not stop sandboxes already using this instance.
form.maxConcurrentRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100000, or leave it empty.

warning.shareRotation: This login is shareable, and its definition says the tokens may rotate. Sandboxes sharing one instance can sign each other out; prefer separate instances.
warning.foreign: Hosts you don't own will receive this login's values, and their operators could read them. Only allow this for hosts whose operators you trust.

detail.notFound: This login doesn't exist or was deleted.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.copyBackHint: Save refreshed tokens from the sandbox when it stops.
settings.foreignHint: Off: this login only runs on your own hosts.

edit.title: Edit login
edit.description: Rename the login or change how often tokens are checkpointed.

repin.title: Change the definition version of {{name}}
repin.description: Moves the login to another version of the same definition. Stored values are re-encrypted for the new version. Not possible while a sandbox is using the login.
repin.noVersions: No other version of this definition is available.
repin.confirmErase: This change erases the stored proxied values. Type “{{name}}” to confirm.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Deletes the login with all its accounts, instances and stored values. It is refused while a sandbox is using the login.
delete.typePrompt: Type the login's name to confirm

accounts.heading: Accounts
accounts.description: One account per provider account you sign in with. Each account holds one or more instances.
accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.addDescription: Use a separate account for each provider account. Then add an instance to hold its tokens.
accounts.pauseHint: A paused account is not given to new sandboxes. Running sandboxes keep it; free it per sandbox.
accounts.deleteDescription: Deletes the account, its instances and their stored values. It is refused while a sandbox is using it.
accounts.deletePrompt: Type the account's name to confirm

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Add an account, add an instance to it, then upload a value.

instances.heading: Instances
instances.label: Instances of {{account}}
instances.addDescription: An instance is an independent set of tokens. WS Sandbox Proxy cannot check that it belongs to this provider account; log in to it with the same account.
instances.exclusiveHint: Each instance of an exclusive login is used by one sandbox at a time.
instances.deleteDescription: Deletes the instance and its stored value. It is refused while a sandbox is using it.
instances.deletePrompt: Type the instance's name to confirm

upload.title: Upload a value for {{name}}
upload.description: Values are write-only: WS Sandbox Proxy encrypts them and never shows them again.
upload.filesHint: Pick each file from your computer. At most {{max}} KiB in total. Upload directory contents through the API.

problem.tooLarge: The files are larger than this definition allows.

problem.definitionNotFound: That definition version is not available (it may be archived).
problem.busy: A sandbox or a login session is using it. Free it or wait, then try again.
problem.repinBlocked: A sandbox is using this login, or tokens from a stopped sandbox still need to be recovered or saved. Try again once they settle.
problem.repinIncompatible: That version changes the sharing mode or no longer supports proxied delivery, so the login can't move to it.
problem.repinConfirmErase: This version changes the proxy settings. Type the login's name to erase the stored values and continue.
problem.valueInvalid: The value doesn't match the definition.
problem.valueInvalidEntry: The value for {{entry}} doesn't match the definition.
problem.definitionCorrupt: The stored definition no longer matches its digest. Re-pin the login to a fresh version.
problem.unavailable: CLI logins are not available on this server right now.
problem.rateLimited: Too many changes in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.forbidden: This change needs a current sign-in by the account owner. Sign in again and retry.

picker.heading: CLI logins
picker.hint: Install up to 8 logins in the new sandbox. Account and instance choices apply to this create only.
picker.oneShot: This choice applies to this request only; a later start picks any available instance again.
picker.proxyNote: Proxied logins can be attached later only to a sandbox created with one: name a proxied login here to turn on the credential proxy for this sandbox. Whether a host can run the proxy depends on the host.

session.title: Login session
session.description: Run the login command in the terminal below, then save. The tokens are stored encrypted; WS Sandbox Proxy never shows them.

stateHint.PROVISIONING: Starting the login sandbox. This page updates on its own.
stateHint.READY: Attach the terminal, run the login command, then choose Save.
stateHint.SAVED: Saved. The instance is ready to use.
stateHint.FAILED: The saved tokens were incomplete. Fix the login in the terminal, then choose Save again.
stateHint.CANCELLED: Cancelled. The instance was not changed.
stateHint.EXPIRED: The login sandbox expired before the tokens were saved. The instance was not changed.

session.foreignHost: This login sandbox runs on a host you don't own; its operator could read the tokens.

command.heading: Login command
command.hint: Copy it, or attach the terminal and use “Type it for me”.
command.doneWhenExits: The login is complete when this command exits.
command.unsupported: This login uses a browser callback, which WS Sandbox Proxy can't run yet. Upload a value instead.

actions.heading: Finish
actions.hint: Save copies the tokens from the login sandbox and stores them encrypted. Check runs the definition's verify command.

verify.unknown: The check ended without an exit code.

session.cancelDescription: The login sandbox is destroyed and nothing is saved. The instance keeps its current value.

consent.title: Use a host you don't own?
consent.warning: None of your own hosts in this pool can run the login sandbox. A host you don't own would receive the tokens, and its operator could read them.
consent.checkbox: I understand; use a host I don't own for this login
consent.required: Tick the box to allow a host you don't own, or choose another target.

start.titleAccount: Add an account by logging in
start.description: WS Sandbox Proxy starts a small, short-lived sandbox where you run the CLI's login command. Nothing is installed in it from this login first.
start.unverifiedAccount: WS Sandbox Proxy can't check which provider account you log in to. Use one account here per provider account.
start.reloginHint: The new tokens replace this instance's value when you save.
start.ownHostHint: Only your own hosts can run a login sandbox directly.
start.placementRequired: Choose where the login sandbox runs.
start.templateRequired: Choose a template with the CLI installed.
start.egressHint: One per line, added to the definition's login domains.
start.egressInvalid: Enter at most 32 domains, one per line, with no spaces.
start.timeoutHint: 1 to {{max}}. The sandbox ends after this time if you haven't saved.
start.timeoutRange: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to {{max}}.
start.uploadHint: Open the instance's Upload to store a value directly.

leases.heading: Holders
leases.label: Holders of {{instance}}
leases.noCheckpoint: No checkpoint newer than the stored value.
leases.forceReleaseDescription: The instance becomes free at once. The sandbox's copy of the login is no longer saved back, and its files are removed at its next start.
leases.lostRotation: If the provider rotated the tokens inside that sandbox, the newest tokens are lost and the stored value may stop working, so you may need to log in again.
leases.promote: Keep checkpoint #{{seq}} as the stored value
leases.releasedPromoted: Lease released; checkpoint #{{seq}} is now the stored value.

rejected.heading: Rejected captures
rejected.description: Token captures that failed checks are kept on the host, encrypted, until you discard them.
rejected.label: Rejected captures
rejected.discardDescription: Hosts delete these captures. They can't be recovered afterwards.

type.capture_lost: Tokens could not be saved back
type.checkpoint_promoted: Checkpoint kept as the stored value
type.bundle_redelivered: Login sent again after a host reconnect
